magnetic_model: Each formula unit has one tetrahedral Asite and two labelled octahedral Bsites. Both Bmoments are parallel and antiparallel to A;all site moments are collinear. Measured net moment magnitude per formula unit is4mu_B. Use the supplied ionic moment model exactly;no orbital,covalent or noncollinear corrections are included.
spectral_model: A separate ideal spectral measurement resolves Fe(II)and Fe(III)but not individual sites. Integrated line area equals number of ions times a known per-ion response factor. Fe(II)factor is2and Fe(III)factor1. The observed normalized areas are[0.5,0.5]in[Fe(II),Fe(III)]order. Equal areas are not stipulated equal ion counts.
target: Use actual formula stoichiometry,neutrality and the moment observation to retain every allowed site-valence assignment. Report Fe(II)/Fe(III)counts per formula unit,all retained vectors in source site order,and whether ALL labelled sites have identified valences. Check whether the spectral areas agree with those counts after response correction;do not infer counts directly from equal raw areas.
scope: Formal-valence and ionic-moment consistency only. The model does not prove a real magnetite charge-order structure or experimentally validate integer local valence.

provenance.kind: Controlled conditional solid-state model;inputs are stipulated,not experimental structural assignments.
